snippet.title: Moonfrost - Official Early Access Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Take a look at gameplay, building, and more from Moonfrost in this trailer for the upcoming life sim RPG. Moonfrost will be available in Early access on Steam on October 12, 2026.

In a world ravaged by meteor storms, begin your cosy yet epic journey as a Frost Hunter in Moonfrost! Rebuild a shattered village whilst enjoying a life of farming, crafting and befriending charming neighbours as you uncover the dark truths behind the mysterious Second Moon.
